phase: Repository Provenance Integrity Hardening — Terminal Assessment
purpose: Freeze the current repository-wide provenance-integrity boundary after the post-v0.3.0 hardening series, so future work can distinguish a genuinely new provenance trigger from repeated re-auditing of already closed surfaces.

hardening_series.interpretation: Successive repairs bound processed sidecars to exact artifacts, separated hash-backed and normative-semantic source evidence, reconciled a legacy monetary diagnostic, clarified processed-data current/legacy scope, enforced provenance-governance parity and synchronized versioning rationale.

established_invariants: Every top-level data/source_vintages directory is registered by an explicit provenance-anchor class.
Ordinary LOCAL_MANIFEST anchors contain at least one SHA-256 identity; normative semantic evidence is classified separately when source bytes are intentionally not redistributed.
Every CSV under data/processed is registered, repository-identity pinned and classified as current/partial/diagnostic or legacy-reconciled through its provenance class.
Every declared processed-data sidecar identifies the exact processed artifact it governs.
ASSESSMENT_EMBEDDED, ASSESSMENT_PLUS_SOURCE_VINTAGE and LEGACY_RECONCILED_BY_SUCCESSOR entries have at least one declared authority that explicitly references the processed artifact.
Validation Recovery uses an exact five-file repository input surface pinned independently of incomplete historical provider-envelope recovery.
The model contract and scientific baseline register the same source-vintage, processed-data and validation-recovery provenance authorities.
explicit_non_claims: Inventory coverage does not prove external-source truth or eliminate provider revision risk.
A review-only or external review-copy anchor is not upgraded to byte-exact source-vintage reproducibility.
The ESA 2010 normative-semantic source is not claimed as a repository-retained PDF vintage.
Validation Recovery does not have a complete byte-identical historical raw-provider vintage because the historical BIS transport payload remains unrecovered.
Processed-data inventory membership does not imply canonical/current scientific status.
Provenance integrity does not validate behavioural mechanisms, causal interpretation, calibration, forecasts or policy simulation.
Provenance integrity does not complete the Accounting Spine or activate System Dynamics feedback loops.
reopen_conditions: A new top-level data/source_vintages directory or a new provenance-anchor class is introduced.
A CSV is added to, removed from or byte-changed under data/processed.
A processed artifact changes provenance class, sidecar binding, authority chain or source-vintage anchor.
The Validation Recovery repository-input surface or raw-recovery classification changes.
A CI/audit failure demonstrates a broken hash, authority, schema or cross-registry provenance invariant.
A future release milestone deliberately changes the provenance-governance contract.
